prompt:
Create one genuine six-phase EAST ATTACK sprite sheet for the exact original UNIQUE boss Girtas. First reference is the exact original portrait and absolute identity authority. Second reference is its faithful enlargement draft for readable same-character materials. Do not use any other design.

Transparent1024x1536 canvas, exactly TWO COLUMNS x THREE ROWS of512x512 cells; one complete full-body pose per cell, phases0..5 row-major. Same E/screenRIGHT side-on elevated game camera for every frame. Face, chest perspective, boots and attack aim stay EAST; torso can coil modestly without flipping to front, back or west. Same anatomy, same proportions, same body scale, same weapon, same anatomicalRIGHT weapon hand throughout. Near-camera right arm holds the original weapon in every frame; the free far left hand braces naturally, never swaps weapons.

IDENTITY IS FIXED: pale visible human face and long pale/silver hair, original gold/black high head ornaments, long THIN hard GOLD RADIAL SPINES physically attached to back/shoulder structure, original long DARK skirt/coat lower armor with gold edge trim and dark boots. Preserve the original long THIN SINUOUS orange/gold glowing weapon and its original curve, length and hand. It is not a short broad sword, not a newly invented spear or chain whip. It can rotate and swing with its grip but cannot change shape, length or become a straight broad blade. NO closed redV mask, NO thick orange flame-feather wings, NO muscular demon redesign, NO fitted segmented leg replacement. All rigid radial spines retain original attachments; they are not fluttering wings. Conservative hidden-side detail only.

SIX ACTUAL ATTACK PHASES:0 calm ready guard facing right, same weapon held low/trailing as original.1 ANTICIPATION: raise the RIGHT weapon forearm and bend right elbow, loading the same long curved weapon behind/above the right shoulder; body stays right-facing.2 COIL: knees flex, hips/torso turn only slightly within the east profile, right shoulder drawn back, weapon hand behind shoulder ready to extend; clearly different from both guard and contact.3 ACTIVE CONTACT: drive right shoulder and FULLY EXTEND anatomicalRIGHT/near-camera arm horizontally toward screenRIGHT, grip and SAME long sinuous weapon clearly reaching EAST/right in front of the torso at chest height; hips transfer weight into the forward/right boot, face still right profile. This is the contact frame, not a guard or a weapon pointed left/downward.4 FOLLOW-THROUGH: right arm and weapon continue a controlled downward/rightward arc past contact; elbow starts relaxing and body settles, stillE.5 RECOVERY: return to the original low ready guard, feet planted and stable, no new gear or pose alias. Six anatomically coherent distinct poses, not a static figure with an independently pasted blade.

FRAMING: Preserve full body, every existing radial spine, hair, ornaments and the ENTIRE long curved weapon in ALL6 cells, especially the fully extended contact. Use the SAME conservative scale in all6: helmet-to-boot CORE BODY approximately250-270px tall, with full combined spines/body/extended weapon silhouette fitting inside local x45..467,y45..467 of each512cell. Center torso around local x220; leave actual space to its right for the long contact weapon. Do not enlarge idle frames then shrink contact; no cropping, inter-cell overlap or changing weapon length. Consistent boots baseline near y435 with only natural knee flexion. Clear transparent gutters.

Detailed opaque dark armor/gold material. Alpha0 outside physical silhouette, including between hard narrow spikes; localized weapon glow only, no detached particles, floating rays, glow clouds, shadow, ground, backdrop, grid, number, label, text or border. Final art is faithful native game animation source, not poster art. Prioritize exact original character and actual articulated contact sequence.
